    m.addConstr(8.34 * vars['Var_0_block1'] + 9.43 * vars['Var_1_block1'] + 3.25 * vars['Var_3_block1'] + 6.09 * vars['Var_4_block1'] + 4.86 * vars['Var_5_block1'] <= 150.61, name='C5_block1')
